The amount of resources to be used for highway construction are small when compared to the abundant resources available within the southeastern region and the depletion of these materials is insignificant.
The committment of an alternate site for relocation of General Mitchell Field can not be justified. SEMPPC's projections show that the Milwaukee Metropolitan community will not drow large enough to demand another regional airport. This alternate was dropped from consideration in SEMRPC's Regional Airport System Plan because of inherent problems of obtaining sufficient lands for a large airport as well as encountering environmental, economic and political difficulties.
